# LKAP (LiveKit Agent Platform)

> A configurable voice/video agent platform on LiveKit: connections, agents
> (prompt or flow), providers and keys, knowledge bases (with evaluations
> and bring-your-own stores), HTTP/MCP tools, connected apps through
> Composio, panels, telephony, sessions, QA, simulated-caller tests, caller
> memory, guardrails and costs — all reachable by a coding agent through one
> MCP server, `lkap` (package name lkap-mcp, `mcp/`). There is no CLI.

Start with the platform guide, then the reference docs below. A coding agent
should call `lkap_guide()` (an MCP tool the server exposes) rather than
reading these files directly whenever that tool is available; the files
exist for Codex, generic agents, and anyone browsing the checkout.

## Guidance

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): connect the MCP server, the workflow, the safety
  rules — written for Codex and other agents that read this file
  automatically.
- [mcp/README.md](mcp/README.md): install for every client (Claude Code,
  Codex CLI, Cursor, generic), every environment variable, the tool catalog
  by domain, remote (HTTP) mode.
- [mcp/claude-plugin/skills/lkap/SKILL.md](mcp/claude-plugin/skills/lkap/SKILL.md):
  the same guidance packaged as a Claude Code skill
  (`scripts/install_claude_skill.sh` installs it on its own).

## Design docs

- [docs/v3/AGENT-ACCESS.md](docs/v3/AGENT-ACCESS.md): the full design —
  object model, the tool catalog, the console's connect flow, safety
  mechanisms, remote mode.
- [docs/v2/HANDOFF.md](docs/v2/HANDOFF.md): the platform itself (connections,
  agents, packs, panels, telephony) below the agent-access layer.
- [docs/v5/ARCHITECTURE-V5.md](docs/v5/ARCHITECTURE-V5.md): what v5 added —
  the knowledge service, connected apps, MCP sign-in, caller files, consent,
  privacy, languages, tests, telephony, listen-in, guardrails, memory, panel
  blocks — with an index of every v5 decision and ruling.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): the repository overview (every package, running
  the platform locally).
